scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Short Term Training (PMKVY)
disclaimer: This is AI-generated guidance based on official scheme documents. It is NOT an official government notification. For final decisions, visit the official websites or contact your nearest government office.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Guarantees old-age pension for unorganised-sector workers aged 18-40; focuses on retirement income security.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Provides skill training for youth aged 15-45; focuses on job readiness, employment, and livelihood improvement.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Age 18–40 at joining; must hold a savings bank/post office account; NOT an income-tax payer; not part of organised sector pension schemes.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Age 15–45; Indian national; must have Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked bank account; school/college dropouts or unemployed preferred.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Guaranteed monthly pension (₹1,000–₹5,000) from age 60 until death; spouse gets same pension after subscriber dies; nominee gets remaining corpus.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free skill training (theory + soft skills + entrepreneurship); placement assistance; accidental insurance; travel cost; boarding & lodging; post-placement stipend.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Long-term: contributions from joining (age 18–40) until age 60; pension received from 60 onwards, lifetime.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Short-term: training duration varies by job role (weeks to months); placement support continues post-training.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Subscriber contributes monthly/quarterly/half-yearly via auto-debit (amount depends on chosen pension slab and entry age); government co-contributes (for pre-31.03.2016 joiners).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Mostly FREE training; higher NSQF Level 5+ courses may be fee-based, but weaker/marginalised sections get support.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar (primary KYC); active savings bank/post office account with auto-debit enabled; OTP-based eKYC online.
comparisons.scheme1_alternative: Offline: APY registration form at bank/post office branch.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar (mandatory at enrolment); Aadhaar-linked bank account; role-specific criteria defined by awarding body.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online (net banking): log in to internet banking, search APY, fill details. Online (eNPS): visit enps.nsdl.com, complete Aadhaar OTP eKYC. Offline: visit bank/post office branch with APY form.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Visit nearest training centre (find at pmkvyofficial.org/trainingcenter) or register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in).

comparisons.scheme1_value: No deadline; can enrol any time between ages 18 and 40. Contributions continue until age 60.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No fixed deadline; training batches run year-round. Check nearest training centre for next batch start date.

comparisons.scheme1_value: From 01.10.2022: income-tax payers are barred from joining. If found to be an ITR payer later, account may be closed.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar is mandatory. Minimum 70% attendance required to appear in assessments.

comparisons.scheme1_value: [Red flag] Income-tax payers barred from 01.10.2022. [Yellow flag] Overdue interest and charges apply for delayed/missed contributions. [Green flag] Free grievance redressal at npscra.nsdl.co.in.
comparisons.scheme2_value: [Red flag] Aadhaar mandatory; 70% attendance mandatory. [Yellow flag] Higher NSQF courses may be fee-based.
Skill India Digital: skillindiadigital.gov.in. Training centre locator: pmkvyofficial.org/trainingcenter.

recommendation:
**Choose APY if:** You are aged 18–40, work in the unorganised sector (small business, daily wages, agriculture), are NOT an income-tax payer, and want a secure monthly pension after age 60. You need financial discipline to contribute regularly until retirement. 

**Choose PMKVY if:** You are aged 15–45, are unemployed or a school/college dropout, want to learn a job skill quickly (weeks to months), and need placement support to get employed soon. You prefer earning immediately rather than waiting 20+ years. 

**You can do BOTH:** They serve different goals. Upskill with PMKVY now to improve employability and income, then enrol in APY once you have stable earnings and are under 40.
